coverage.universeDescription: Every United States court of appeals constituted by 28 U.S.C. § 41, every judicial district established by 28 U.S.C. ch. 5 and by the Title 48 organic acts, the statutory divisions those sections create, and the bankruptcy court 28 U.S.C. § 151 designates in each district, as the U.S. Code stands at release point 119-102.
